item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00474","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C10","C12"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C05 supplies a concrete agency-level appeals framework that plausibly served as a drafting template: department and agency heads prescribe procedures under government-wide Civil Service Commission oversight; employees receive an appeal, written-request review, a fair hearing, and corrective disposition. The child generalizes and elaborates this machinery from discrimination complaints to adverse personnel actions. C10 closely anticipates employee participation and adaptation to differing agency structures, while C12 contains an older multi-level personnel-appeal system, but C05 is the closest overall operational template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The head of each department and agency... shall establish within the department or agency a system for the reconsideration of administrative decisions to take adverse action against employees.","parent_excerpt":"The head of each executive department and agency... shall... [p]rescribe regulations... that will insure a complainant of an appeal to the proper authorities within his department or agency, a fair hearing, and a just disposition of his case.","explanation":"Both direct each agency head to create an internal system for reviewing contested personnel decisions."},{"child_excerpt":"The Civil Service Commission shall... issue regulations to put this order into effect and shall make a continuing review of the manner in which this order is being implemented by the departments and agencies.","parent_excerpt":"The Civil Service Commission shall in connection with its responsibilities under the law issue such regulations as may be necessary to implement the policy of this order.","explanation":"Both combine decentralized agency procedures with central implementing regulations from the Civil Service Commission."},{"child_excerpt":"An appeal shall be in writing... [and an employee] shall, on his request, be granted one hearing.","parent_excerpt":"upon the written request of the complainant, the complainant's case shall be referred to the Committee for its review and an advisory opinion","explanation":"The child adapts the parent's written-request review and hearing protections into a broader adverse-action appeal process."}]}
